tasks.title: analytics engine
replay library
library and statistics pages
pitch drawing and replay view
match library API
expectations: Match ids are validated by one function before any file access, so path traversal is impossible
Writes to the store are atomic (write to a temporary file, then rename); a crash cannot leave a half-written match
The router contains no business logic; MatchStore holds it
All error responses go through one helper that returns the error body and the right status
The analytics module is imported lazily and its result is cached on disk
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job

tasks.title: match library application
expectations: Importing the library app never imports torch, cv2, numpy or the live pipeline
The README section describes only behaviour that exists in the code
The existing serve and run commands behave exactly as before
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job

tasks.title: review and harden the analytics engine
expectations: Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job
No logic is duplicated between functions; shared steps live in one helper
Errors are explicit: bad input raises a clear error or returns a clear failure, nothing is silently swallowed
Speed and distance step logic lives in one place and is used by players and by the ball
A recording of 100,000 frames with 22 people is summarised in under 15 seconds (measure it)
Input frames are never modified and there is no global state

tasks.title: review and harden the replay library
expectations: All functions are pure and never modify their inputs
The Timeline depends on the clock only through the injected clock
Every edge case in the task text (empty list, single frame, duplicates, seek past the end) has a code path and a comment
No logic is duplicated between functions; shared steps live in one helper
Errors are explicit: bad input raises a clear error or returns a clear failure, nothing is silently swallowed

tasks.title: review and harden the pages and render library
expectations: Every piece of data shown goes through textContent or an equivalent, never innerHTML, so recorded names cannot inject markup
Both pages are usable at 400 px width and have readable colours in light and dark colour schemes
Buttons are real buttons, tables have header scopes, links have text
A failed or empty API response shows a clear message, not a blank page or a console error
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job

tasks.title: review and harden the pitch and replay view
expectations: Pure functions never touch the DOM or the canvas
The replay panel loads frames in chunks, keeps a bounded cache and prefetches before the end of a chunk
Space toggles play and pause only when no input has focus
The animation loop stops when the page is hidden
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job
